limitations: No cue-dependent failure is supported for this checkpoint in these samples. An unresolved matched location gate does not rule out global color dependence or untested cues.

Pilot location tests describe pilot weights, not the final checkpoint. CAMs provide class-associated activation and do not establish causal influence or correctness; selected examples are illustrative.
CAM normalization can hide differences in absolute activation. The diagnostic fix is independently verified locally, but no training repair was run or claimed verified.

Historical initial-attempt failures and rejected interventions remain preserved in shortcut_repair.ipynb. Final protocol was developed on training/validation evidence and was not preregistered; it used a new frozen test offset.

Training comparator ties occur at the accuracy ceiling; accuracy does not establish invariant logits. Three synthetic seeds and image-resampling descriptive intervals do not establish population generalization or CAM incremental value; no non-CAM targeted selector comparator was trained.

No follow-up training, owner data changes, data collection, checkpoint edits, or deployment performed. Fresh bounded diagnostic verification reused the trusted notebook generator without duplicating training code.
